eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Lincoln, WA; at 5:19 PM on AUG 13, 2025 Effective until 9:19 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: We have a fire in the Whispering Pines / Crescent Rd area north to the Spokane River. We have a fire in the Whispering Pines / Crescent Rd area burning north to the river.  If you are in this area prepare to evacuate. Further notices will be coming. Call 911 for emergencies.
